channel.title: Español desde cero
channel.description: Spanish from zero, hands-free. The thousand most common words, forty an episode, each one inside a short story about everyday life. Listen first, speak later. Half an hour each, sized to the subway.
channel.itunes:author: Griffin Thomas

item.title: 1. Lo primero
item.description: 40 new words, a story built from them, and review of everything before. Story: Griffin bumps into a stranger at a coffee shop in New York. It turns out they're both waiting for the same coffee.

item.title: 2. Querer y poder
item.description: 40 new words, a story built from them, and review of everything before. Story: It's Saturday. Griffin and his friend Marco can't decide what to do. Marco wants to go out, Griffin wants to eat.

item.title: 3. La gente
item.description: 40 new words, a story built from them, and review of everything before. Story: At Ana's party, Ana walks Griffin around and introduces him to everyone, including her very large family.

item.title: 4. Números y tiempo
item.description: 40 new words, a story built from them, and review of everything before. Story: Monday morning. Griffin is running late, the subway is stuck, and his boss Elena keeps texting.

item.title: 5. La comida
item.description: 40 new words, a story built from them, and review of everything before. Story: Griffin and Marco go to a small Mexican restaurant. The waiter keeps bringing the wrong thing.

item.title: 6. Cómo estás
item.description: 40 new words, a story built from them, and review of everything before. Story: Monday at work. Griffin's coworker Luis asks about the weekend. Griffin is exhausted from Ana's party, and Luis has news.

item.title: 7. Verbos, parte uno
item.description: 40 new words, a story built from them, and review of everything before. Story: Marco grew up in Mexico and learned English as a kid. Griffin asks how, and Marco explains, which turns out to be the exact method this podcast uses.

item.title: 8. Verbos, parte dos
item.description: 40 new words, a story built from them, and review of everything before. Story: On the subway, an older woman named Carmen sits next to Griffin and starts asking him questions. He understands more than he expects.

item.title: 9. La ciudad
item.description: 40 new words, a story built from them, and review of everything before. Story: A tourist named Rosa is lost in Manhattan. She asks Griffin for directions to a museum, and he gets her there, mostly.

item.title: 10. Lo que pasó
item.description: 40 new words, a story built from them, and review of everything before. Story: Griffin left Ana's party early. The next day Ana tells him everything he missed, and Marco did not have a good night.
